name: What is the process for a tile and surface update project?
description: The process involves consultation, material selection, demolition, installation, grouting, and a final walkthrough.

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a tile and surface update project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process typically begins with an initial consultation and site visit to discuss your vision, assess the current conditions, and take measurements. Next, we help you select materials and finalize design plans. We then proceed with demolition, surface preparation, installation of new tiles or surfaces, grouting, and sealing. Finally, we conduct a thorough cleanup and final walkthrough to ensure your satisfaction with the completed project.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, material selection, demolition, installation, grouting, and a final walkthrough.
